docs.title: Install CB POS
docs.summary: How to download and install CB POS on Windows 10 or later.
docs.body_md:
# Install CB POS

CB POS runs on Windows 10 or later as a standalone desktop application. It requires no internet connection to bill.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 (64-bit) or Windows 11
- 4 GB RAM recommended
- 500 MB free disk space

## Installation steps

1. Download the installer from the CB POS website.
2. Run the `CBPOSSetup.exe` installer.
3. Follow the 2-minute setup wizard.

docs.title: How VAT and SSCL are calculated
docs.summary: Understanding VAT and SSCL calculations from shelf price.
docs.body_md:
# How VAT and SSCL are calculated

CB POS calculates Sri Lankan 18% VAT and 2.5% SSCL automatically backwards from the shelf price.

:::disclaimer
CB POS calculations are not certified by the IRD. Always verify with your tax advisor.
:::

## Calculation Formula

Shelf Price = Base Price + SSCL (2.5%) + VAT (18%).
